disposition.approved_target: approximately one third public and two thirds sealed
disposition.current_split: 228 public / 456 sealed (33.3% / 66.7%); meets the approved target
disposition.retired: 93 items (ScreenSpot 45, ScreenSpot-Pro 31, Android-in-the-Wild 17) were moved from public to sealed on 24 Sep while their inputs and every system's predictions sat in a non-sealed job folder. They are retired: not scored and not relabelled.
disposition.fresh_items: 333 fresh sealed items were drawn from our private synthetic rotation pool (stratified by family and difficulty, seeded draw); all 12 systems were run on them with the same code, pinned revisions, prompts and settings as their original v0.1 run.
disposition.frozen_before_results: Split counts and hashes were frozen and posted before any system saw a fresh item.

method.split: An item is public if it was exposed anywhere (Mind2Web-derived, shown in videos or on this page, or present in the public site repository since the 21 Sep preview). Sealed items are the never-exposed v0.1 items plus 333 fresh items from our private synthetic rotation pool. 93 items whose inputs and predictions were stored outside the sealed store are retired.
method.intelligence: Chance-corrected accuracy per part, weighted 35% public / 65% sealed.
method.overfit_penalty: Matched-family public-minus-sealed accuracy gap (ScreenSpot and Everyday photo, inverse-variance weighted). Above 15 points, Intelligence is multiplied by 1 - (gap - 15)/100. Same rule for every system.
method.calibration: 10-bin top-label ECE scaled by valid probability coverage, 35% public / 65% sealed; label-only outputs receive zero calibration.
method.speed: p50 and p95 whole-call latency; local latency uses the v1.4 2× plus 0.15-second adjustment. For self-hosted systems the original run's timings are combined with the fresh-item run on the same GPU type.
method.cost: Hosted cost uses returned usage receipts: OpenRouter receipt costs for four endpoints and the saved Autoloops per-request Gemma 4 31B token usage priced at published rates. Missing receipts are not zero-filled; the cost axis is scaled by receipt coverage. Local cost uses measured GPU seconds at the recorded per-system GPU-hour rate.
method.composite: Equal-weight harmonic mean of Intelligence, Calibration, Speed, and Cost, followed by the v1.4 intelligence, speed, and cost gates below 50.
method.difficulty_caveat: The 333 fresh sealed items are our own synthetic images and renders. They are easier for frontier API models than the older real-source items, so sealed accuracy is higher than on the earlier split for most hosted systems.

exposure.hosted: Four OpenRouter systems (GPT-6 Luna low, GPT-5.6 Luna, Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite and Gemini 3.8 Flash) received sealed images and questions through the requested no-retention route with provider fallback disabled, for the original items and the fresh items alike. Gemma 4 31B used the Autoloops endpoint; no provider no-retention claim is made for that endpoint. All five hosted rows carry the API flag.
exposure.label_checkers: GPT-6 Luna and Gemini 3.8 Flash saw 100 public promo-photo candidates and 68 new sealed-photo candidates in stateless single-turn label checks, including candidates later dropped. No gold labels were shown; human gold-blind review decided inclusion.
exposure.djev_spark: djev-spark saw the 100 public promo photos in the earlier inference-only video run, with no training. Its score on the 95 sealed photo items is the independent measure.
exposure.jev_omni: This checkpoint was measured on a separate frozen JevBench v1.4 text set before this run. It received no ImageJevBench task input before this evaluation.
exposure.bonsai: Bonsai-2-27B v2 (PQ2_0 weights, Q8_0 MMProj) was measured offline on 24 Sep; the clean PNG-normalized rerun is scored.
exposure.gemma: Autoloops – Gemma 4 31B IT: results on the original items are reused from the completed Autoloops measurement; the 333 fresh sealed items were run on 25 Sep with the original Autoloops runner. Returned per-request token usage is costed at the published Gemma 4 31B rates.
exposure.fresh_pool: The fresh pool items were authored with Claude and reviewed by OpenAI Codex as a blind critic, and the pool photos were generated with an OpenAI image model. This is disclosed for the two OpenAI rows. Self-hosted systems ran the fresh items on one rented GPU pod in offline containers with read-only inputs.
